tools.title: Work tools
tools.description: Project journals, material planning, procedures, practice and saved views.
tools.reserve: Include this bill in material planning
tools.reserveHelp: Active bills with this option contribute to planned demand. This does not move or consume physical stock. Completed bills stop contributing.
tools.label: Material name
tools.templateHelp: Each run keeps its own copy of the steps and notes. Editing this procedure does not change existing runs.
tools.question: Question
tools.markdownStorage: Saved as a regular Markdown record.
tools.studyCompleteHelp: The schedule below shows the next review dates. Add cards or return when another review is due.
tools.ratingHelp: Rate your recall. Again schedules another review today; other ratings schedule a later day.
tools.help.journal: Record completed work, findings, time spent and the next step. Link the entry to a project.
tools.help.bom: List required materials, link inventory items and calculate shortages from current stock and planned demand.
tools.help.procedure: Create reusable steps and start independent runs with persistent checklists.
tools.help.cards: Write questions and answers with references to your notes. Reviews are scheduled from your ratings.
tools.help.view: Save filters and rules. Results update automatically from the current Markdown files.
tools.bomHelp: Free stock equals available units minus other active planned bills. This bill's own demand is not subtracted twice. Loaned units are not available.
tools.overbooked: Planned demand exceeds available stock. Review the linked bills before allocating materials.
tools.nothingMissing: All listed materials are available after other planned demand.
tools.runHelp: These steps and notes are a snapshot of the procedure when this run started. Progress is saved after each change.
tools.viewHelp: This view reads the whole library using its saved filters. The toolbar filters the list of saved views, not these results.
